Use case: identity-preserve.
Make a highly localized iris-color correction to Image 1. Image 1 is the edit target and determines the entire final photograph. Image 2 is a COLOR REFERENCE ONLY: borrow only the muted pale gray-blue iris pigmentation visible in its softly lit eyes. Do not borrow its face pose, expression, exposure or lighting.

Change only the colored irises in Image 1: a gray-dominant, softly cool blue-gray, low saturation, with a slightly darker natural outer iris rim and subtle radial texture. Bring the lit iris gently toward Image 2's pale blue-gray so the blue component is readable without becoming vivid, icy white, turquoise or green. Apply the same underlying pigmentation to both eyes, while retaining Image 1's existing directional illumination: the shadow-side iris stays much darker. Preserve black pupils, pupil size, iris size and position, existing catchlights, sclera, eyelids, brow and exact gaze. Do not brighten the shadow-side eye to match the lit eye. No glowing or contact-lens effect.

Preserve Image 1's facial expression exactly, including the quietly closed mouth, brow position, eye opening, head pose and facial anatomy. Keep all other content unchanged: short dark hair, skin color and texture, chin and jaw, body and hands, clothing, chair, background, framing, global exposure and side-light shadow pattern. This is a subtle iris recoloring of the existing photo, not a redesigned portrait or relighting. Photorealistic color, same vertical 3:4 composition, one image, no labels or collage.
assets.recommended_use: 后续近景、眼色与神态连续性参考；保留年龄感、持续凝视和自然闭口。
